tools.name: search_resources
tools.description: Lists paid resources for sale on Ethereum Sepolia. Use it to find a resource id. It does not negotiate or pay.

tools.name: get_quote
tools.description: Returns the list price, floor, volume discounts, and URL for one resource. Use it when you already have a resource id. It does not change the price or pay.

tools.name: negotiate_price
tools.description: Proposes a test-USDC unit price and a quantity of paid accesses on Ethereum Sepolia. Use it to accept the tier price or receive a counteroffer. It does not pay.

tools.name: prepare_checkout
tools.description: Builds a checkout summary and a single-use confirmation for an accepted offer. Use it to review the amount before paying. It never pays.

tools.name: pay_and_access
tools.description: Pays an accepted offer with its single-use confirmation, or returns x402 payment requirements for a public caller. This is the only tool that spends. The server wallet signs only for the owner key on Sepolia testnet.

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Redeems or retrieves an already-paid Sepolia purchase by transaction hash. Use it to deliver a paid resource. It never charges.

tools.name: get_checkout_status
tools.description: Reports whether a checkout is pending, paid, consumed, expired, or cancelled. Use it to read the amount, units remaining, and expiry. It does not pay or cancel.

tools.name: cancel_checkout
tools.description: Invalidates an unused single-use confirmation so it cannot be paid. Calling it again is safe. It cannot cancel a payment that has already settled.
